name: yunikorn-core-bounded-metrics-cardinality-4f35
instr:
Apache YuniKorn lacks a common cardinality boundary for dynamic Prometheus dimensions in queue, runtime, scheduler-resource, and event metrics. Add one that retains admitted identities, aggregates denied observations into bounded overflow measurements, and preserves existing behavior when governance is not configured.

Give each category an independent finite limit; zero means unbounded admission. Collectors must not create governed identities before admission. Admission is idempotent by category and identity, remains occupied while any owner holds a lease, and becomes reusable when `CardinalityLease.Release` removes the final owner.

Preserve admitted values and aggregate rejected numeric observations into deterministic category-specific overflow. Continue ignoring unsupported runtime sample kinds. Repeated gauge updates must replace prior overflow, clear stale overflow, and retain existing zeroing for disappeared admitted queue resources. Queue and resource retirement must release ownership exactly once without erasing persistent terminal counters or accumulated rejection history.

`CardinalityController.Report`, `QueueMetrics.CardinalityStatus`, `RuntimeMetrics.CardinalityStatus`, and `SchedulerMetrics.CardinalityStatus` must expose the same nonmutating category limit, live count, rejected total, and overflow total in category-name order; internal collection records that view. `GetMetricsCardinality` and `WebService.GetMetricsCardinality` must serve `GET /ws/v1/metrics/car
